authority: The canonical anatomy documents are the exhaustive product contract. This inventory maps each stable anatomy identifier to executable task leaves; code selector discovery is supplementary and is never claimed exhaustive.

coverageDefinitions.canonicalAnatomy: The normative complete map: sheet → section → control → opened menu or form → field → validation, behavior, and exact state copy.
coverageDefinitions.selectorInventory: A current-code discovery aid. It may be incomplete and does not substitute for the canonical anatomy map.

mappings.anatomyPath: Product Sheet > Prices > Customer confirmations > shared in-place settings modal door and history restoration
mappings.reason: Product-context door opens the shared settings modal without a send/price command; Back/Forward restores modal and selected preview state.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations row/deep route > shared settings modal > focus/history return state
mappings.reason: Operations route opens the same shared modal with named close, focus return and Back/Forward selected-preview restoration.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > independent policy controls and effective-policy explanation
mappings.reason: Durable, revisioned confirmation policy gates with exact customer-facing consequence copy.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > customer-scoped preview > subject and incomplete-price state
mappings.reason: Scoped preview selection and truthful current-price/incomplete state; preview never sends.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > Product requests and options > policy field
mappings.reason: Revisioned no-auto-SKU and ERP line-mapping policy with reviewed product/ERP boundaries.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > settings save > durable-write failure alert and focus return
mappings.reason: Prior effective policy remains active after a failed durable write; error copy is part of the command contract.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > settings sheet footer > Done close action
mappings.reason: Closes the named settings surface only; no second save, send or publish action is implied.

mappings.anatomyPath: Operations > Customer confirmations > preview > operator incomplete-price review status
mappings.reason: Operator-only missing-price status distinguishes review work from the separate customer preview and no-send/provider state.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > sequential handoff > exact SKU code/search > identity resolution
mappings.reason: Exact folded SKU-code resolution before name matching in the stock-update chooser.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > no exact SKU match > deliberate New product route > no stock/price prefill
mappings.reason: Unknown product recovery opens reviewed PRD-C01 with source context but no selected SKU, stock/price prefill, mapping screen or automatic relation.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > resolved SKU > Receive stock / Record a stock count > no-recorded-yet state
mappings.reason: One resolved SKU hands the user into the canonical receipt/count editor with a named pre-command state.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > chooser-origin editor > Save & next item > accepted independent movement > empty next chooser
mappings.reason: Save-next is an acknowledged independent receipt/count with lot invariant, no cross-item draft inheritance.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > chooser-origin editor > Save and finish / direct-sheet editor separation
mappings.reason: End-of-sequence action is distinct from direct Product Sheet save and does not create a bulk transaction.

mappings.anatomyPath: Stock update > save conflict/failure/cancel > current-item draft retention
mappings.reason: Failure/cancel preserves only the current revisioned item and cannot advance across an unaccepted movement.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán > Paper check > stage/source/photo intake and local retry state
mappings.reason: Revision-bound paper/source review with safe photo retention and no automatic extraction or document mutation.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán > Paper check > Finish review > later canonical print gate
mappings.reason: Final-paper state requires explicit completed review plus a later canonical print; neither earlier print nor omitted flag suffices.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > working-paper correction > actual quantity/unit-price/weight fields
mappings.reason: Visible actual fields submit ordinary revision-checked line commands, separate from photo intake and global price/lot mutation.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > note > Comments boundary and recurrence fact
mappings.reason: Internal order note/recurrence evidence remains explicitly non-customer and non-catalogue authority.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > Comments > Keep/review product option decision and review panel
mappings.reason: Scoped literal note review separates order note, candidate product review and document consequence.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > product-option review > reusable name/customer-visible text fields
mappings.reason: Draft product/option fields remain distinct and cannot become product or outward wording by typing alone.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > product-option review > approve/remove customer snapshot and indicators
mappings.reason: Explicit approved customerOption snapshot controls outward projection independently of SKU, price, document issue and delivery.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán line > product-option review > Create separate product/Keep comment/Cancel actions
mappings.reason: Candidate product creation is separate reviewed command; keep/cancel leaves product and customer output unchanged.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán/customer paper > approved customerOption outward projection and safety filter
mappings.reason: Only approved customer-audience snapshot passes to customer/document/ERP composition; internal note remains excluded.

mappings.anatomyPath: Albarán > line discussion and header navigation
mappings.reason: Separate audience, evidence, draft, scope and layer navigation.

mappings.anatomyPath: Shell > output panel > print geometry
mappings.reason: Compact viewport-safe layout preserves output semantics.

mappings.anatomyPath: Units > tenant vocabulary > global UnitConversion > product override > line snapshot
mappings.reason: Single Product Unit; reusable global conversions with exact-SKU overrides; exact/nominal/catch-weight evidence, precision, immutable commercial snapshot and failure recovery.
